verdict.rationale: The evidence documents pay-as-you-go pricing with no subscription, and rate-limit tiers that advance as you spend on API credits. Nothing in the pack mentions a free tier or free credits for API calls. The no-API-key interactive Playground for Search is a console UI, not free programmatic API access, so it counts only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype against the API on a free tier or free credits
